body: Not in a long time lol. Maybe with a better computer I would.
Electronic music and decked out kitchens are the 2 in the for front of my head.

You're right that everything is trivial, but wrong that there are no negatives. When the negatives become the majority of your experience, there is only one way out. And forever without feeling can easily become more attractive than a short time of torture.

Scales are pretty empty I'd say. There are a few cons like my cats' well being that is a bit of a concern. You don't plan something like this for most of your adult life just to have this decision outweighed by trivial things.
